in_sanskrit.name: Juri
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Radiant, Light
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Juri एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Juri is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jvala' which means 'radiant' or 'light'. In Hindu mythology, Juri is a name given to the Sun God, Surya, who is the symbol of light, power, and energy. The name is also associated with courage, strength, and wisdom.
